Placeholder layout roles

Source: R/placeholders.R
placeholder_layouts.Rd

Returns the lookup that maps each layout role used by placeholder slides (such as section) to a template layout and the placeholders it fills.

Usage

placeholder_layouts(
  overrides = getOption(option, list()),
  defaults = placeholder_layout_defaults(),
  option = "autoslider.core.placeholder_layouts"
)

Arguments

overrides

A named list of role overrides. Defaults to the option named by option.

defaults

The roles to start from.

option

Name of the option holding session-wide overrides.

Value

A named list of roles.

Details

Each role is a list with:

  • layout, master: the template layout to add the slide on.

  • labels: field name to placeholder label (ph_label in officer::layout_properties()), and/or

  • types: field name to placeholder type (type in officer::layout_properties(), e.g. "title", "body"). A label wins over a type for the same field.

  • fallbacks: field name to another field. Text for a field the layout has no placeholder for is added to the other field, before its own text. The default section role (the "Section Header" layout has a title and a text box, but no subtitle) sends subtitle to text, so a speclayout written for a template with a subtitle still renders without losing text.

Overrides are merged per role, and labels, types and fallbacks per field, so changing one layout name or one label keeps everything else. New roles can be added the same way.

See also

validate_placeholder_layouts(), append_section_slides()

Examples

placeholder_layouts()$section
#> $layout
#> [1] "Section Header"
#> 
#> $master
#> [1] "Office Theme"
#> 
#> $types
#> $types$title
#> [1] "title"
#> 
#> $types$text
#> [1] "body"
#> 
#> 
#> $fallbacks
#> $fallbacks$subtitle
#> [1] "text"
#> 
#> 

# A template whose divider layout is called "Chapter divider"
placeholder_layouts(list(section = list(layout = "Chapter divider")))$section$layout
#> [1] "Chapter divider"
